Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 05 July 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Cavite, Metro Manila and Rizal within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
